3:22.hebrew: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה כִּי לֹא־תָמְנוּ כִּי לֹא־כָלוּ רַחֲמָיו׃
3:22.english: By YHWH’s acts of steadfast love we have not perished, for His compassions have not come to an end.

3:23.english: They are new every morning. Great is Your faithfulness.

3:24.hebrew: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה אָמְרָה נַפְשִׁי עַל־כֵּן אוֹחִיל לוֹ׃
3:24.english: “YHWH is my portion,” says my soul. “So I will hope in Him.”

3:29.hebrew: יִתֵּן בֶּעָפָר פִּיהוּ אוּלַי יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה׃
3:29.english: Let him put his mouth in the dust. There may yet be hope.
